This small plot near my home is where I grow the maize that feeds my children. I will try to buy a little fertilizer if I can get the AIP coupon from the government, because the soil here is tired and without it the maize will not yield. I keep a few chickens and goats, so I will carry their manure to this plot before the rains. I cannot afford to irrigate or hire many workers — my husband and I will do the weeding ourselves, and I will plant the hybrid seed I saved money for because it gives more cobs than the local seed my mother used.
